'''Chay Tebbic''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who worked as a bartender in the [[Cantina Oceana]] in [[Dorumaa City]] on [[Dorumaa]]. After she had worked there for several years, she witnessed a fight between [[Echari Di'San]] and [[Rysko Barnt]] in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. Barnt was murdered shortly afterward, and Tebbic called the authorities to inform them of the crime.
